info.title: ZoneFlow local API
info.summary: REST API of the ZoneFlow standalone firmware.
info.description: Served by the controller on the local network. Not tested on hardware yet: the firmware has run only in host unit tests. Every route is checked against the firmware route table by `test/host/web_openapi_test.cpp`.

get.description: Whether an admin password exists and whether this request carries a valid session. For a cookie session it also returns the CSRF token, so a reloaded page can recover it.

post.description: Rate limited per client address (5 free failures, then 1 s doubling to 15 min) and in total (30 failures in 5 min lock everyone out for 60 s). A refused attempt answers 429 with Retry-After.

200.description: Logged in. Also sets the `zf_session` cookie (HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict).

post.description: Only while no password exists. The setup code is shown on the device display and serial log, never over the network; knowing it proves physical access. Rate limited like login.
Ends this session and clears the cookie.

200.description: Changed. Every other session is signed out; this is the new one.

put.description: Partial update. Turning HTTPS on or off takes effect after a reboot (`restart_required`).

get.description: Everything a dashboard needs in one call: zones, master, queue, sensors, rain delay, inhibits, faults, network and OTA state.

On connect the server sends a `state` message (same body as GET /status), then one message per change: `event` for each controller event, `state` when the snapshot changed (at most every 500 ms, and at least every 30 s), `network` and `ota` when those change, and a comment line every 15 s as keep-alive. At most 3 streams are open at once; a fourth gets 503.

200.description: An endless `text/event-stream`. See the API reference page for the event names and payloads.

parameters.name: zone
parameters.description: Zone number as printed on the terminal block, 1 to zone_count.

patch.description: Changes the zone's entry in the configuration. Validation errors name the field in `error.path`.

parameters.name: zone
parameters.description: Zone number as printed on the terminal block, 1 to zone_count.

post.summary: Run a zone for N seconds
post.description: Adds a manual run to the end of the queue. The zone driver clamps the time to the zone's `max_run_s` (the answer shows the clamped value). Refused (409) for a disabled or locked-out zone, without 24 VAC, and during maintenance (OTA).

parameters.name: zone
parameters.description: Zone number as printed on the terminal block, 1 to zone_count.

post.description: Closes the zone if it is the running queue entry (the queue then moves on). A zone that is only queued further back gives 409 `not_head`; use POST /queue/stop.

parameters.name: zone
parameters.description: Zone number as printed on the terminal block, 1 to zone_count.

202.description: Command queued for the control task

post.description: Without `id` the next free id is used. At most 16 programs. Fields left out take their defaults.

put.description: Replaces the whole program; fields left out take their defaults. `error.path` is relative to the program, for example `starts[1]`.

post.description: Queues every zone of the program (manual program run; seasonal adjustment applies).

202.description: Command queued for the control task

post.description: Closes the running zone and keeps its remaining time.

202.description: Command queued for the control task

post.description: Reopens the paused zone for its remaining time.

202.description: Command queued for the control task

post.description: Drops the head entry and starts the next.

202.description: Command queued for the control task

post.description: Closes everything and empties the queue.

202.description: Command queued for the control task

put.description: Scheduled starts are skipped until the time given; manual runs still work. Needs a valid clock (409 `time_not_set` otherwise). At most 30 days ahead.

202.description: Command queued for the control task

post.description: A fault whose cause is still present is raised again on the next sample.

202.description: Command queued for the control task

put.description: Validated as a whole; nothing changes on error and `error.path` names the field. Missing fields take defaults, unknown fields are ignored. Nested deeper than 16 levels is rejected before parsing.

get.description: The configuration with a small header. Never contains secrets: no WiFi credentials, password hash, sessions, setup code or TLS key.

requestBody.description: A backup file from GET /config/backup, or a bare configuration document.

put.summary: Set the clock or the time zone
put.description: `utc` sets the clock (and the RTC) by hand; SNTP overrides it at the next sync. `timezone` is a POSIX TZ string stored in the configuration.

post.description: The stored WiFi credentials stay until new ones connect; after 15 minutes without a new setup the device returns to the stored network. Same as the long-press on the device.

get.description: Used by the setup page on the SoftAP. Never returns the setup code.
Only while SoftAP provisioning runs (409 `not_provisioning` otherwise). The setup code is the WPA2 passphrase of that access point, so a client on it has already proven it knows the code.

post.description: Only while SoftAP provisioning runs. Optionally sets the first admin password.

202.description: Handed to the provisioning manager; poll GET /provision

post.description: Outputs are forced off by the restart handler.
Stops watering, then erases configuration, runtime state, WiFi credentials, the admin password, sessions, web settings and the TLS certificate. The setup code is kept so a printed label stays valid.

Refused (409 `zones_active`) while a zone runs unless `force=true`. Before writing, the controller is put in maintenance mode, which closes every valve and blocks starts. The header is checked (ESP32-S3, project `zoneflow-fw`) before anything is written; the image is verified at the end. The new image must confirm itself after boot, otherwise the bootloader rolls back.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Update even while watering (outputs are still forced off first).

requestBody.description: The raw application image (`zoneflow-fw.bin` from a release).

202.description: Verified and set as boot image; the device restarts

post.summary: Download and install an image from a URL
post.description: HTTPS only, checked against the ESP-IDF certificate bundle; redirects are followed (GitHub release assets redirect to a CDN). Same safety rules as upload.

202.description: Download started; follow GET /firmware or the `ota` stream event

post.description: Replaces the web UI files. Does not touch the firmware or settings.

requestBody.description: A LittleFS image of the `www` partition (`www.bin` from a release).

202.description: Written; the UI is served from it at once

bearerAuth.description: Token from POST /auth/login. Scripts use this; no CSRF header needed.

cookieAuth.name: zf_session
cookieAuth.description: Set by login. Writes with the cookie also need the X-CSRF-Token header.

path.description: JSON path of the offending field, when there is one.

csrf.description: Only for a valid cookie session.

token.description: Bearer token; the same value is in the cookie.

csrf.description: Send as X-CSRF-Token on writes that use the cookie.

tls_fingerprint_sha256.description: Of the self-signed certificate; empty if none.

protect_reads.description: GET routes need a session too.

https.description: Serve on port 443 with a self-signed certificate.

check_host.description: Refuse requests whose Host is not this device.

anchor.description: First day of an interval rule (local).

durations_s.description: Seconds per zone; index 0 is zone 1. 0 leaves the zone out.

obey_sensor.description: Skip while the rain sensor is active.

anchor.description: First day of an interval rule (local).

durations_s.description: Seconds per zone; index 0 is zone 1. 0 leaves the zone out.

obey_sensor.description: Skip while the rain sensor is active.

ProgramInput.description: Same as Program. `id` is optional on create and must match the path on replace.

RainDelayRequest.description: Exactly one of the two fields.

until_utc.description: Unix seconds, within the next 30 days.

Config.description: The configuration document described in the firmware architecture, section 6. Missing fields take defaults; unknown fields are ignored.

local.description: Local wall-clock time, ISO 8601 without offset.

password.description: Empty or absent for an open network; else 8 to 64.

admin_password.description: Sets the first admin password if none exists.

BadRequest.description: Invalid body or parameter; `error.path` names the field

Unauthorized.description: No valid session (`unauthorized`), or no admin password yet (`password_not_set`)

Forbidden.description: Host not this device (`bad_host`), cross-origin write (`bad_origin`) or missing CSRF header (`csrf`)

NotFound.description: No such zone, program or route

Conflict.description: Refused in the current state (zone disabled, inhibited, update running, ...)

TooLarge.description: Body larger than the route allows (checked before reading)

TooManyRequests.description: Too many failed attempts; see Retry-After
